title: When Is Graph Structure Worth Its Cost? The Case for Structure Pricing in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.18099v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can help answer questions that require information from many documents. However, building a graph often requires many language-model calls during ingestion. It is therefore important to ask whether its quality gains justify the additional cost.   We present EffiRAG, a graph-based RAG system designed to reduce this cost. It uses the graph to locate relevant passages and generates answers from the original text. This design preserves source information while keeping graph construction and query processing lightweight.   We evaluate EffiRAG on UltraDomain, which contains 120 open-ended questions from four domains. Compared with LightRAG-hybrid, EffiRAG produces the preferred answer on 93 questions. translated_title: 何时图结构才物有所值？论检索增强生成中的结构定价
translated_abstract: 基于图的检索增强生成（RAG）可以帮助回答需要从众多文档中获取信息的问题。然而，构建图通常需要在数据摄取阶段进行多次语言模型调用。因此，重要的问题是其质量提升是否足以证明额外成本的合理性。我们提出了EffiRAG，一个旨在降低这种成本的基于图的RAG系统。它利用图来定位相关段落，并从原始文本生成答案。这种设计在保持图构建和查询处理轻量化的同时，保留了源信息。我们在UltraDomain上评估了EffiRAG，该基准包含来自四个领域的120个开放式问题。与LightRAG-hybrid相比，EffiRAG在93个问题上生成了更受偏好的答案，LightRAG仅在7个问题上更受偏好，其余20个问题为平局。EffiRAG还将系统总成本降低了57%，从0.952美元降至0.408美元。该成本包括数据摄取期间的语言模型调用。
tldr: EffiRAG是一种轻量级的基于图的RAG系统，通过图定位相关段落并从原文生成答案，在UltraDomain基准上以93比7的优势胜过LightRAG-hybrid，同时将系统总成本降低了57%。
en_tdlr: EffiRAG is a lightweight graph-based RAG system that uses the graph to locate relevant passages and generates answers from original text, outperforming LightRAG-hybrid 93 to 7 on UltraDomain while reducing total system cost by 57%.
